name: B10-0423/2026 – After § 19 – Am 4
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 19a. Calls for a stricter and more transparent framework governing the disbursement and oversight of EU development and cooperation funds to non-EU countries and non-governmental organisations; insists on the introduction of robust mechanisms allowing for the immediate suspension and full recovery of funds in cases of insufficient accountability or traceability, as well as in cases where beneficiaries are hostile to the EU, or refuse to cooperate on returns or the fight against organised crime and trafficking in human beings and drugs;
